## 🌿 Comprehensive Botanical Ingredients & Formulations

### 1. Madhumeha Sanjeevani / Mukti (Diabetes Root Cure)
- **Active Ingredients**: Gudmar (*Gymnema sylvestre*), Jamun seed (*Syzygium cumini*), Karela (*Momordica charantia*), Vijaysar (*Pterocarpus marsupium*), Methi Dana, Shuddh Shilajit.
- **Mechanism**: Rekindles natural pancreatic beta-cell insulin synthesis rather than artificially exhausting the body. Helps patients break free from lifelong chemical tablet dependency.

### 2. Shecurevedic (Period Care, Cramp Relief & Gynaecological Health)
- **Target Demographic**: Girls and women aged 15–25 and above.
- **The Modern Allopathy Crisis**: Modern hospitals prescribe expensive hormone pills and surgeries costing families ₹5 to 10 Lakhs. These synthetic pills cause lifelong endocrine disruption, extreme weight gain, cystic acne, and secondary complications.
- **Shecurevedic Formulation**: Ashoka Chhal (*Saraca asoca*), Lodhra (*Symplocos racemosa*), Shatavari, Dashamoola, and Kumari (Aloe Vera). Calms uterine muscle spasms, ends severe lower-belly cramps, normalizes cycle frequency, and clears menstrual clotting.

### 3. Raktachap Shanti (High Blood Pressure & Cardiac Vitality)
- **Active Ingredients**: Shuddh Sarpagandha (*Rauvolfia serpentina*), Arjuna Chhal (*Terminalia arjuna*), Ashwagandha, Brahmi.
- **Mechanism**: Relaxes vascular tone, dissolves micro-plaque in coronary arteries, stabilizes autonomic nervous tension, and normalizes both systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

### 4. Dant Suraksha Manjan & Oral Elixir (Daat ki Dawa / Pyorrhea)
- **Active Ingredients**: Pure Clove (Laung) oil, Babool chhal, Akarkara (*Anacyclus pyrethrum*), Bakul, Neem bark, Majuphal, Camphor (Kapoor).
- **Indications**: Chronic toothache, bleeding gums, loose teeth, pyorrhea, bad breath, hot/cold water sensitivity.

### 5. Liv-Amrit / Liver Sanjeevani Rasayana (Fatty Liver Detox)
- **Active Ingredients**: Kutki (*Picrorhiza kurroa*), Bhumi Amla (*Phyllanthus niruri*), Kalmegh (*Andrographis paniculata*), Punarnava (*Boerhavia diffusa*), Kasani.
- **Indications**: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD Grade 1 & 2), elevated SGOT/SGPT enzymes, sluggish digestion, jaundice, loss of appetite.

### 6. Top 10 Energy, Stamina & Shilajit Formulations
1. Pure Himalayan Shilajit Gold Resin (>80% Fulvic Acid, 84+ minerals)
2. Ashwagandha KSM-66 Vitality Rasayana
3. Safed Musli & Kaunch Beej Power Compound
4. Gokshura Athletic Endurance Tonic
5. Chyawanprash Supreme (Wild Amla & Swarna Bhasma)
6. Swarna Bhasma Rejuvenator
7. Shatavari Hormonal Vigor Rasayana
8. Vasant Kusumakar Ras
9. Triphala Rasayana
10. Brahmi & Shankhpushpi Neuro-Energy Tonic

### 7. Tulsi Vedic (Pancha Tulsi Drops)
- **Active Ingredients**: Steam-distilled extracts of Rama, Krishna, Vana, Shukla, and Kapoor Tulsi.
- **Indications**: Chronic cough, seasonal viral flu, chest congestion, sore throat, allergies, weak immunity.

### 8. Sandhivata Mukti (Joint Pain, Ghutno ka dard & Arthritis)
- **Active Ingredients**: Shallaki (*Boswellia serrata*), Nirgundi, Gandhapura, Rasna, Mahanarayan Taila.
- **Indications**: Knee joint pain, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, cervical spondylosis, sciatica.

### 9. Kesh Sanjeevani (Hair Fall, Dandruff & Scalp Care)
- **Active Ingredients**: Bhringraj, Brahmi, Amla, Shikakai, Jatamansi.
- **Indications**: Severe hair fall, thinning hair, alopecia patches, dandruff, premature graying.
